_format: 5 tapered tiers (docs/gameplay-decisions.md §6.3), rate = stat points gained per level while inside that tier. bonus(stat, level) = floor(sum of the tier rate for every level-up from 2 up to `level`). eliteMultiplier applies to a boss-room monster's fully-scaled stats (asymmetric on purpose — see §6.5, uniform x2 let boss defense stack high enough to nearly negate all incoming damage at deep floors).
